ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Python SDK for building A2UI agents. Generates LLM system prompts from
component/function catalogs, parses and validates model responses against
those catalogs (including streaming), and provides catalog configuration,
transformers, and inference-format helpers on top of a2ui-core's protocol
and data models.

and data models.

name: a2ui-agent-sdk
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.11.0"
  test_skip_args: >-
    -m "not performance"
    --ignore=tests/conformance
    --ignore=tests/elemental/test_compiler.py
    --ignore=tests/elemental/test_format.py
    --ignore=tests/elemental/test_parser_decompile.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_cli_tools.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_compiler.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_integration.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_parser_decompile.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_round_trip.py
    --ignore=tests/express/test_version_compliance.py
    --ignore=tests/parser/test_streaming_patterns.py
    --ignore=tests/skill/test_skill_generator.py
    --ignore=tests/test_catalog_resolver_peers.py
    --ignore=tests/test_catalog_transformers.py
    --ignore=tests/test_formats.py
    --ignore=tests/test_framework_agnostic.py
    --ignore=tests/test_specification_roundtrip.py
    --deselect=tests/test_pydantic_builders.py::test_accessibility_attributes_match_the_v0_9_1_schema

package:
  name: a2ui-agent-sdk
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/a2ui-agent-sdk/a2ui_agent_sdk-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9e922ade1747e29bb3fc6e41c3a30dc7cc99eb4ffd81c89f68dc59dd6dfe778c

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - a2ui-core >=0.6.0,<0.7.0
    - antlr4-python3-runtime >=4.13.0,<4.14.0
    - jsonschema >=4.0.0
    - pydantic >=2.11.0
    - pyyaml >=6.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - a2ui.constants
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - if: win
        then: >-
          python -m pytest tests/ --import-mode=importlib ${{ test_skip_args }}
          --deselect=tests/processor/test_catalog.py::test_resolve_examples_path_handling
        else: >-
          python -m pytest tests/ --import-mode=importlib ${{ test_skip_args }}
    files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytest-asyncio

about:
  homepage: https://a2ui.org/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A2UI Agent SDK
  description: |
    Python SDK for building A2UI agents. Generates LLM system prompts from
    component/function catalogs, parses and validates model responses against
    those catalogs (including streaming), and provides catalog configuration,
    transformers, and inference-format helpers on top of a2ui-core's protocol
    and data models.
  repository: https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/tree/main/python/a2ui_agent

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pb01ka
